decisions.reason: The flagship transactional email service draws directly on the firm's core messaging knowledge and data centers, so it can read market feedback and keep improving the service through its own R&D.

Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow direction, but recognition technology lies further from its messaging core and its visibility since 2019 is unconfirmed, which raises the risk of refocusing.

This fax optimization feature is cheap to run on existing know-how, but fax is a declining channel and the firm already withdrew its fax conversion service, so it may be folded into the base fax offer.
Sandbox protection strengthens the email security portfolio, where the firm's existing security expertise lets it absorb new threat information and keep refining the product.

Multi-engine scanning is a natural extension of the secure messaging service that the firm can operate and refine with knowledge it already holds, though it could be merged into broader security bundles.
